name: Shopping arcade
desc: A glazed passage of small shops - somewhere to walk and talk out of the weather.
tags: covered shopping arcade, glass barrel roof, iron roof framework, patterned tiled floor, shopfronts on both sides, hanging shop signs, potted plants, wrought iron balustrade, upper gallery, daylight through the glass roof
prose: a covered shopping arcade running between two rows of shopfronts, a glazed iron roof overhead spilling daylight onto the tiled floor and an upper gallery set behind a wrought-iron balustrade
note: The word arcade also drags in video game cabinets, so glazed roof, ironwork and shopfronts have to be present to hold it to the architecture. Same tags decide the other split: keep them and you get the Victorian glass-and-iron passage, drop them and it slides into a modern shopping centre. The roof is the light source, so a night scene needs lit shopfronts named instead or the whole arcade goes black.
